title: Feeling place names
description: About 3,400 US lakes, creeks, peaks and towns are named for an emotion, from Mount Pleasant to Lake Desolation. For every one named for a bad feeling, four are named for a good one. Pleasant alone appears 1,334 times, then Hope and Happy; on the gloomy side Lonesome leads, then Dismal and Mad, with Disappointment Peak, Mount Despair and a place in Idaho called Good Grief. Hover any dot for its name. Names from the USGS Geographic Names Information System.
